artifact: FACT DUEL Game and Experience Design
scope: Independent product gameplay, psychology, accessibility and sound research; no Site mutations or user tests performed

sources.author_or_publisher: Ryan, R. M.; Rigby, C. S.; Przybylski, A. K.
sources.title: The Motivational Pull of Video Games: A Self-Determination Theory Approach
sources.access_scope: Original research, author-hosted PDF; abstract and relevant results/limitations inspected
sources.supports: Autonomy, competence and relatedness associations with game enjoyment and future play
sources.limitations: Sampled game genres and assigned play differ from voluntary browser trivia; not a product-retention estimate

sources.author_or_publisher: Roediger, H. L.; Karpicke, J. D.
sources.title: Test-enhanced learning: taking memory tests improves long-term retention
sources.supports: Retrieval benefits on delayed recall compared with restudy
sources.limitations: Students studied prose and completed free-recall tests; not this timed four-choice product

sources.author_or_publisher: Butler, A. C.; Roediger, H. L.
sources.title: Feedback enhances the positive effects and reduces the negative effects of multiple-choice testing
sources.supports: Immediate/delayed feedback increased later correct recall and reduced distractor intrusions versus no feedback
sources.limitations: Educational experiment does not validate game speed or retention uplift

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things, Revised and Expanded Edition
sources.access_scope: Author synopsis and table of contents
sources.supports: Signifiers, feedback, conceptual models, errors and iterative human-centered design as review lenses
sources.limitations: Full book not read; recommendations are original applications of identified themes

sources.title: Don’t Make Me Think, Revisited: A Common Sense Approach to Web Usability, third edition
sources.access_scope: Publisher overview and table of contents; published 2013-12-23, copyright 2014
sources.supports: Intuitive navigation, concise copy, mobile usability and usability testing
sources.limitations: Full book not read; no universal quantitative conversion claims

sources.title: The Art of Game Design: A Book of Lenses, Third Edition
sources.access_scope: Publisher featured-book description; exact product-page fetch failed
sources.limitations: Full book not read; specific lenses/checklists in brief are original synthesis

sources.title: A Theory of Fun for Game Design: Excerpts
sources.access_scope: Author-published chapter-one excerpt, prologue and contents
sources.supports: Practitioner examples of disengagement with too difficult, too easy or exhausted challenge
sources.limitations: Excerpt is not complete book or empirical validation; historical anecdotes not current market facts

sources.title: Universal Patterns in Color-Emotion Associations Are Further Shaped by Linguistic and Geographic Proximity
sources.supports: 4598 participants, 30 nations, 22 languages; shared associations with local linguistic/geographic modulation
sources.limitations: Color-term association study; cannot predict specific interface trust, calm, conversion or performance

sources.author_or_publisher: Brewster, S. A.; Wright, P. C.; Edwards, A. D. N.
sources.title: Guidelines for the Creation of Earcons
sources.access_scope: Author university-hosted research guidance based on six experiments
sources.supports: Distinct timbre and rhythm, short cues, narrow controlled intensity; avoid pitch-only distinctions
sources.limitations: Historical interface findings; proposed sounds and durations need device and listening tests

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.supports: Contrast, reflow, focus, keyboard, status and reduced-motion design targets
sources.limitations: Design brief is not a full accessibility audit or conformance certification

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.5.8: Target Size (Minimum)
sources.access_scope: Official informative explanation of WCAG 2.2 AA criterion
sources.supports: 24 by 24 CSS px minimum with exceptions; larger targets support easier activation
sources.limitations: Brief proposes 44px controls and 56px answer pads, not the normative AA minimum

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.5.2: Pointer Cancellation
sources.access_scope: Official informative explanation of WCAG 2.2 A criterion
sources.supports: Prefer release/click for ordinary controls; limited essential down-event exceptions
sources.limitations: Game status is not blanket exemption; timed pad rationale and accessibility behavior require review

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.2.1: Timing Adjustable
sources.access_scope: Official informative explanation of WCAG 2.2 A criterion
sources.supports: Turn off/adjust/extend time with limited real-time and essential exceptions
sources.limitations: Untimed practice improves inclusion but does not alone establish whole-product conformance

original_calculations.method: WCAG sRGB relative luminance contrast ratio, opaque solid colors only

implementation_status: Recommendations and acceptance gates only; root implementation determines shipped scope
book_coverage: Accessible descriptions, contents and Koster chapter-one excerpt; complete books were not read or downloaded.
